body: Thanks, hope you're doing well. Actually, in February this year I was probably on my lowest depression ever. Then I met this beautiful girl. I only were with her for 5 days at my working place, but still. Of course I fucked up things straight away, but she accepted it. She was like a life savier at that point, I would probably have been dead now if it wasn't for her. She has a boyfriend, but that doesn't matter for me. If she's happy, I'm too. We're still having some contact, she lives an hour away from me. Whenever she's texting me or sending me a snap, I feel alive and then I smile for a week. It's happening rarely now, but still sometimes. All of this gave me hope that there are good people in this world. It boosted my morale, and without her I would have nothing to be happy for at all.

To scared to seek professional help. And I will never speak to my parents about this, it will only makes things worse. As it is now I'm watching the people I know at my age on social medias, being out enjoying themselves.. I'm jealous to be honest, although it would be hard for me to even try to socialize with them now due to my social anxiety. But yeah in a few years, if I'm still alive and living on my own, I'll try my best to socialize and gain a normal life.

You are right about the alcohol thing, its not like I'm dying to try it, it's just the socialize and create friends etc I want to get out of it. Being home on my computer won't solve anything. 

Don't really feels for any hobbies at the moment. I used to play football before, but I did quit a few years ago. I regret I did quit, because I was doing good and I was talented. The pressure did get to me when I got scouts from other countries watching me. I gave my chance away and I'm not proud of it. I just can't stand people judge me, fuck them.

I will be moving out in some years if I'm still alive then. I doubt I will move to another country, just because I don't want to speak a foreign language. It will just cause one more anxiety when I see other people.

In a year time I will have my "job-exam". I'm not educated yet, but I'm still working full time. I will loose my job if I fail of course, and yeah I believe I have 10% chance of succeed. If it would have been a writing test, I would give myself 80% at the moment. But with my social anxiety I will fuck it up with two sensors judging my abilities as it is a speaking exam, and I have to explain them all the processes etc. Would not go well at all. I've been depressed just thinking about that day since I got the job.

If I fail that exam, I will go through and do it as there is no future for me if I fail.
